recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future Immunization non-administration wording should be handled under the current statusReason/status model, not by restoring the retired DSTU1 reasonNotGiven element name.
issue_request: FHIR-5351 is a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 ballot comment for FHIR-core Immunization and ImmunizationRecommendation asking to replace the Immunization refusal-specific element name refusalReason with the more general reasonNotGiven. Its Jira resolution says the request duplicates FHIR-3762.
initial_application: FHIR-3762 was Published/Persuasive with Modification and approved refusedIndicator -> wasNotGiven and refusalReason -> reasonNotGiven. Commit 64fbbf28ef27948a7944954073c8df878bac2bc9 explicitly named #3762 & #5351 and changed the Immunization source spreadsheet and refused example accordingly.
additional_context: Later R4 Immunization workflow alignment intentionally retired the DSTU1 not-given element names: 4c5a8902abffdfb5b6e9f07b4bca119d875dc64a replaced completed + notGiven with status not-done, and f451f3fc4b093f23541fadb82141a50def0e1cc5 added statusReason. FHIR-9073 records that R4 removed notGiven/notTaken and added not-done, and FHIR-54325 later refined the current statusReason wording and invariant for not-done or entered-in-error.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. The latest combined-branch source actively includes Immunization, has no active Immunization.refusalReason, Immunization.reasonNotGiven, Immunization.refusedIndicator, Immunization.wasNotGiven, Immunization.notGiven, or Immunization.notTaken element definitions, and represents non-administration reasons with Immunization.statusReason.
